_comment: Authorization's rights, shipped as a library layer (composition D4): the passkeys page, granted to
signed-in users and only on the types this library ships (Passkeys, PasskeyRow). Every one is the
caller's own account -- PasskeysActions and PasskeyRowActions start from the request principal and
nothing else -- so an application needs no grant to have the page. PasskeyRow gets Query and never
Read: its rows have no detail page. PasskeyRename is a retry prompt and needs no right.
Drop one grant with { "key": "authorization:<key>", "$remove": true }, or all of them with
